title: What Is An American State National?
summary: Promoter explains American State National status as freedom from corporate government, statutes, licensing and detention, with UCC 1-308 as a lifeline.

assertions.quote: they're not subject to or under the jurisdiction of corporate governments such as U.S Inc
American state Nationals have limited diplomatic immunity
American state Nationals are neither obligated nor Bound by law to have driver licenses or even business licenses
these codes and statutes are only the bylaws of the corporation
UCC 1-308 is a Lifeline for free men and women to uphold the constitution
Sally A Jones all caps is referring to a corporation
the fines can be up to one million dollars per day for however many days the American State national was detained

verdicts.note: No law sets such fines; self-styled fee schedules are unenforceable and suits on them are dismissed.

assertions.quote: when you're standing on the land the supreme law of the land it is a higher law and the lower law must yield
in the 14th Amendment it basically put everyone into slavery

verdicts.note: The amendment conferred citizenship and equal protection; it created no corporate status or second-class citizen.
